opportunities.title: Conference Attendance Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of The Physiological Society (Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full and Fellow members). Postgraduate, Full and Fellow applicants must be submitting/presenting an abstract.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support member engagement at Society meetings and Society-sponsored events, covering registration, meeting dinners, and a contribution toward travel and accommodation. Postgraduate, Full and Fellow member applicants must be submitting/presenting an abstract at the meeting they wish to attend.

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of The Physiological Society whose host institution is willing to administer the award.
opportunities.summary: To support members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct a piece of publishable educational research that addresses a key question in physiological education. Funds must be used within 12 months of the grant award date.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of The Physiological Society whose host institution is willing to administer the award.
opportunities.summary: To support members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop a new technique or finalise a project, as well as supporting activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact. Applications should be physiological in nature. Funds must be used within 12 months of the grant award date.

opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow of The Physiological Society.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral researchers who are members of The Physiological Society.
opportunities.summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who require additional support to help them achieve their full potential. Funds can be used for consumables, registration for Higher Education Academy Fellowship or other justifiable sundries (not staff salaries). Funds should be used within 12 months.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full member or Fellow of The Physiological Society in their second year of membership, or longer.
opportunities.summary: Support for Members to run activities that address the principles of Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, intended for projects that directly investigate or address inclusion and diversity issues in the physiological sciences in either teaching or research. Funds must be used within 6 months of the award date.
